nodes.odmowa.text.t: "Pity. A strapping lad like you, and scared of a few furlongs of mud." Ostromir sighs and goes back to patching his wheel.

nodes.prosba.options.[zgoda].text.t: I'll take it. Wait for me at the Ford.

nodes.prosba.text.t: "So, taking the job? Forty groats to see my wagon to Stone Pass. I'll wait three days at the Ford, then I'm going alone, even if they flay me for it."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: The merchant grips your hand in both of his. "Three days! Not a day longer, or my cloth goes mouldy and my wife beats me to death."
